comparison.objective: Calibrate and lock a gripper opening stop versus mix flour and liquid into dough in a loose bowl.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate uses concentric precision tools and countertorque; dough mixing uses one hand to steady a bowl while the other drives a spoon through granular material.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate checks locked angular repeatability; all ten dough specifications score mixed-in flour share while penalizing bowl tipping and material loss.
comparison.reason: Bimanual stabilization is the only shared primitive; the mechanisms and measured outcomes are unrelated.
